name: Elicit
description: Access a corpus of over 125 million academic papers. Search for relevant literature using natural language queries, create structured reports that extract and synthesize data across papers, and retrieve detailed report results — all programmatically. Built for life sciences R&D workflows, the server enables agents to rapidly survey evidence, compare findings across studies, and surface key data points without manual literature review, accelerating everything from target discovery to systematic evidence assessment.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Elicit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Elicit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://elicit.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Elicit MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Elicit provides these MCP tools: search_papers, search_trials, create_report, list_reports, and get_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Elicit?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Elicit in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.
Elicit requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Elicit is developed by Elicit, inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
